F9_repair_sensitivity.measure: repair-touched rows per bank (research/heretic_csi/p6_repair_rows.py -> reports/heretic_csi/hcsi_p6_repair_rows.json): row i of a new bank vs basket's row i after swapping the codeword back (case-preserving incl. ALL-CAPS); self-check: the 4 codewords without their own repair give 0. Counts 0–432 rows/bank (rescue population 0–18 of 1160); Spearman(n_touched, Zipf) over the 20 untouched = 0.512.
preregistered_sensitivity: (S1) H6a/H6b recomputed with every codeword's outcome z AND covariates (installer strength, held-out probe) re-estimated on rows EXCLUDING its repair-touched prompt_ids (the per-codeword lists in hcsi_p6_repair_rows.json).
(S2) H6a/H6b as partial Spearman controlling for log(1 + n_touched) (ranks residualised on rank(n_touched)), permutation p.
Interpretation: if S1 or S2 flips a Holm decision, the primary result is reported as REPAIR-SENSITIVE (not robust); S1/S2 never rescue a failed primary.

F10_power_two_sided_holm.source: research/heretic_csi/p6_power_v2.py -> reports/heretic_csi/hcsi_p6_power_v2.json (H6a one-sided, H6b two-sided; Holm over 2 => conservative per-test alpha 0.025, optimistic 0.05; reliability 0.7)
F10_power_two_sided_holm.finding: the original one-sided alpha-0.05 table overstated H6b's power. Under Holm, at the maximum attainable confirmation n = 15 (20 untouched - 5 DEV, before attrition), conservative power at rho 0.8 is 0.63 (H6b) / 0.74 (H6a); at rho 0.7 0.46 / 0.58.
F10_power_two_sided_holm.UNDERPOWERED_rule_v2: Replaces the '<12' rule. With n_conf = confirmation codewords surviving G1–G3: (a) H6b is PRE-LABELED 'UNDERPOWERED (conservative power < 0.70 at rho = 0.8)' for every attainable n (requires n >= 17 > 15 available) — it is still computed and reported, but a non-rejection may NOT be called a null; (b) H6a is PRE-LABELED UNDERPOWERED for rho < 0.8 if n_conf < 15, and 'CANNOT ANSWER' (no confirmation GPU spent; redesign with new codewords) if n_conf < 12 (conservative power 0.61 at rho 0.8).
F10_power_two_sided_holm.option_for_parent_not_adopted: dropping H6b from the Holm family (descriptive) would restore H6a to one-sided alpha 0.05 (n15 power 0.71 at rho 0.7). NOT adopted here — a change of hypothesis family is the parent's call and must be made before any Stage-0 number exists.
